item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00363","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C19","C12","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C19","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C19 is a particularly strong drafting-template candidate because it concerns one of the same Toledo dock companies and supplies essentially the entire distinctive structure and wording later reused: the three Railway Labor Act findings, the thirty-day reporting requirement, and the statutory prohibition on changes to disputed conditions. The child adapts that template by adding two carriers, changing the represented union, and converting singular references to plural. C12 is nearly as strong because it concerns another named carrier in the child and uses the same operative template. C02 has virtually identical language and machinery but lacks the Toledo-specific continuity.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company, the Toledo Lakefront Dock Company, and the Cleveland Stevedore Company, carriers, and certain of their employees represented by District 50, United Mine Workers of America, a labor organization","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the International Longshoremen's Association, A.F. of L., a labor organization","explanation":"The child reuses the same opening construction and one identical carrier, expanding the regulated parties and substituting a different employee representative."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service","explanation":"The two substantive predicates are reproduced verbatim and in the same sequence."},{"child_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order. As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company, the Toledo Lakefront Dock Company, or the Cleveland Stevedore Company, or by their employees, in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.","parent_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order. As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Toledo, Lorain & Fairport Dock Company or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.","explanation":"The complete operative machinery is materially identical; the child makes only the grammatical and party-list changes required for three carriers and their employees."}]}
